Hi Emma — thanks for the agenda and the time proposal. Quick flag: the US switches to daylight saving time on Sun, Mar 8. That means the UTC offset for our Eastern colleagues will change between now and the meeting on Mon/Tue.

Concretely, 10:00 CET on Tue Mar 9 will be 05:00 EDT for our East Coast team (very early), because of the DST jump on Mar 8. To avoid the early slot I recommend either 14:00 CET (09:00 EDT) or 16:00 CET (11:00 EDT) on Mar 9.

Can you confirm which of those works for you/Oliver? Also, could you please indicate which timezone you mean in the calendar invite (e.g., "10:00 CET / 05:00 EDT") so everyone is clear? I've attached an updated .ics (tentative) with the alternate times — if you confirm I can send a final invite.

Thanks!
